about: Shared test transcripts for the call listener. The engine (engine/tests/test_listener.py) and the app (ScamScorerTest.kt) both check every one: with cues and context only (no LLM), the final level must be between min and max, and the type must match when given. 'expect' is what the Python reference produces (python -m engine.listener.fixtures --update) and the Kotlin port must match it exactly. Written from public I4C / RBI / Sanchar Saathi advisories; no real people.
